spec.description: The unmodified spec passed into the setup process.

errors.description: Any errors that occurred during the setup process.

criticalFunctions.description:
Any functions that are considered critical to a setup process. For example,
{@link IdsDeploymentUtil#deployIdsControlTag} while running {@link IdsDeploymentUtil#setUpDevCluster}.

registerDeploymentEnvironmentPod.description:
Whether or not a {@link Pod} representing the deployment environment was successfully upserted in the IDS control
tag.

registerDeploymentEnvironment.description:
Whether or not a {@link DeploymentEnvironment} was successfully created in the IDS control tag for the deployment
environment.

title: {@link IdsSetupResult} type describing the registration of a deployment environment in an IDS control tag.
name: IdsDeploymentEnvironmentRegistrationResult
